spec.name: scigrid-de Monte Carlo storm-stress base (snapshots 0-5)
spec.description: Base scenario for a StormRisk Monte Carlo study on the PyPSA SciGRID-DE example (reduced 6-snapshot horizon). Load shedding at VOLL. Outages are sampled by StormRisk from the modelled distributions in 'sampling' (same RTS-96-derived classes as studies/scigrid-de-storm-stress.json). n_samples=350 was sized from a measured pilot: 8 single-threaded solves of this 6-snapshot horizon took 3.56-3.81 s each after a 7.13 s first solve, so 350 solves (all sampled states are distinct) fit a ~25 min single-threaded budget.
assumptions: SciGRID-DE (PyPSA example, 2011 data) is a research model of the German transmission grid; results are not statements about the real German system.

outage_classes.name: lines-storm
outage_classes.source: MODELLED author-selected whole-horizon stress probability, not observed or calibrated. Context only: IEEE RTS-96 Table 12 (Grigg et al., The IEEE Reliability Test System-1996, IEEE Trans. Power Syst. 14(3):1010-1020, 1999; https://labs.ece.uw.edu/pstca/rts/rts96/Table-12.txt) lists branch outage rates 0.24-0.54 /yr and typical durations 10-16 h (some 35 h), giving stationary unavailability of order 1e-4 to 1e-3 via lambda*r/8760. q=0.01 is deliberately larger, an illustrative assumption, not a weather multiplier inferred from RTS-96.

outage_classes.name: transformers
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption, not observed data: IEEE RTS-96 transformer branches (Grigg et al. 1999, Table 12: 0.02 outages/yr x 768 h) give q ~ 1.75e-3; rounded to 0.002 and not storm-scaled (substation equipment assumed less weather-exposed than overhead lines).

outage_classes.name: nuclear
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption: IEEE RTS-96 generator reliability data (Grigg et al. 1999, Table 6), 400 MW nuclear unit forced outage rate 0.12. Not German fleet statistics.

outage_classes.name: coal
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption: IEEE RTS-96 (Grigg et al. 1999, Table 6), 350 MW coal/steam unit forced outage rate 0.08. Not German fleet statistics.

outage_classes.name: gas
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption: IEEE RTS-96 has no gas units; the 197 MW oil/steam forced outage rate 0.05 (Grigg et al. 1999, Table 6) is used as a proxy for mid-size thermal plant.

outage_classes.name: oil
outage_classes.source: MODELLED assumption: IEEE RTS-96 (Grigg et al. 1999, Table 6), 20 MW oil combustion turbine forced outage rate 0.10.

probability_model.description: independent whole-horizon component unavailabilities (sampling_spec.outage_classes) and optional demand-multiplier distribution

assumptions: Component unavailabilities are MODELLED inputs (see sampling_spec.outage_classes[].source); they are not observed failure statistics of the studied network.
Components fail independently of each other and of demand; class probabilities do not represent common-mode or weather-correlated failures.
Every sampled outage lasts the whole study horizon (the PyPSA adapter supports topology changes for the whole horizon only); no repair or restoration within the horizon.
Each sampled state is solved as a DC linearised optimal power flow (PyPSA LOPF, HiGHS) with load shedding at VOLL; no AC feasibility, voltage, stability or protection behaviour.
Crude (unstratified) Monte Carlo; uncertainty is sampling error only (CLT normal approximation). Model/parameter uncertainty is not included in the confidence interval.
SciGRID-DE (PyPSA example, 2011 data) is a research model of the German transmission grid; results are not statements about the real German system.
limitations: Not a reliability assessment of any real power system: the probabilities are generic modelled values and the network models are research/example datasets.
EENS here is the expected unserved energy over the study horizon conditional on the base scenario (e.g. its snapshots and demand), not an annual adequacy index.
Importance ranking is descriptive co-occurrence, not causal attribution.
payload.study_title: scigrid-de: Monte Carlo storm-stress EENS (modelled outage probabilities, reduced 6 h horizon, 350 samples)
